statement.zh: 现代综合（Shaw 卷中 Bard 与教材）将埃及国家形成表述为过程而非一战定论；纳尔迈一战统一留假说栏。
statement.en: Modern syntheses (Bard in Shaw volume and textbook) frame Egyptian state emergence as a process rather than a single-battle verdict; single-battle Narmer unification stays in the hypothesis column.
